entries.desc: abi version gate; the loader calls it at instantiate and refuses anything != 1
linear-memory offset for the host-written msgpack args; 0 = refusal

one QVGA frame -> lit regions sorted by area desc, capped at max_regions. cfg (all optional, unknown keys ignored): threshold 0..255 (default 128, lit = luma >= threshold), min_area (default 16), max_regions 1..32 (default 8), discard_first (default true: consume one frame first for AWB convergence — stateless, exactly two camera_frame_get calls). Means are integers 0..255 (no floats in the abi=1 value bridge); luma = BT.601 integer approx (77R+150G+29B)>>8 with 5/6-bit components replicated to 8 bits. Camera must be on at QVGA (caller's responsibility); camera-off or larger framesizes raise the host's rt exception.

linear_memory.note: 11 wasm pages: CCL working set ~627KB (frame 153600 + u16 label map 153600 + parent 76804 + area 153608 + selected map 76804 + heap 8192 + result 4096) + wasm-ld 64KB stack. One ledwatch + one hello co-load fit the board's 1MB WAMR pool; two ledwatch instances do not (loader refuses out-of-memory).

auxiliary.note: wamrc xtensa/esp32s3 output, hash-recorded for provenance. NOT deployable on the current board stack: the loader honestly refuses .aot execution (upstream ESP32-S3 AOT-in-PSRAM defect). Future-ready; never listed in index.json files[].
